content: Ɓad Sǝsǝna ɓa tǝ Pǝɗǝnda
A far wutsǝfayirha na nda aarha pentikos, wumngga fatakkwaya Yeeso hai a mbǝrha tal.
Kula sǝndǝndan sǝ sǝk fad ˈya nda a riirha ƙǝla ɓereu ˈyaara a fǝrakh amshi hai lǝɗanggǝn wuriɗi nana nda sǝ tsǝtsau.
Tǝrgha na ˈya nda kǝla sheneu waarha kyagha sǝ a pathlang ndan a ndǝkrhaɗe tǝ kǝm tǝrgha ten nggindan hai.
Lǝɗangga Sǝsǝna tǝ Pǝɗǝnda kanda heu tǝ kǝm katǝrang ngganda ndikrha hai tǝ fingya miiya ɗǝɗamǝn-ɗǝɗamǝn, kala yanɗi fǝrangna Sǝsǝna tǝ Pǝɗǝnda kanda.
Yahudaya na a tǝrǝm Faara, ɓagha ɓa ahu chehweeya ɗǝɗamǝn na nda ahu Urshalima a sayidɗi.

Sǝk na fiya wumngga hai riirha ǝnɗi kee, tǝrgha ɗaa nda ɓa ka ɓa nda na ǝnɗi katǝragha hai. Ƙǝsangga ǝnwulteena kanda ƙǝsǝr ko wunni sǝkɗǝ kanda a ndikrha tǝ miiyi ndan a mii fatakkwaya hangga wumngga hai.
Əna ǝnwulteena nda, tsakhmee nda, “Nafini heu naa a ndikrha ya, mbǝ Nggalilaya ni wa?
Ƙǝƙǝn ƙǝm kowunni ahur nǝm a sǝk ˈya nanda ndikrha tǝ miighǝn?
Kulo kan kǝm ya Fartiyaya, tǝ Mediyaya, tǝ Elamayaya, tǝ nafiya chehweed Mesofotamiya, tǝ Yahudaya, tǝ yi Kafadokiya, tǝ yi Fantus, tǝ yi Asiya,
tǝ yi Firijiya, tǝ yi Famfiliya, tǝ yi Masar, tǝ kǝm yi na tsau tǝ chehweed Libiya ɗǝgha Sayirin ɗǝ. Rongya ɓagha ɓa a Roma,
Yahudaya tǝ kǝm fingya kyahargha hai na takkwa Yahudaya Kǝrǝstaya, tǝ Laraɓaya. Ƙǝm heu sǝkɗǝm nafiniya a ndikrha tǝ mii nǝm aten ǝngya na mǝmanggǝn ǝnana Faara!
Kanda heu na ǝnwulteena nda tsangga teena kanda, tsahang mee nda fandan, Tur mani ya?”
Amma fingya na ahur fiya wumngga hai na nda a waa farha ndaa nda, “Kanda heu tǝrangna mbaala kanda in!”
Mbiturus pǝrɗǝ laɓar Faara a fiya wumngga hai

Tǝrgha Mbiturus thliighasǝ tǝ fathlǝngya kum kab talɗi, tǝranggǝn uradghǝn sǝ ndanggǝn fiya wumngga hai, “Kun heu kaama thlǝmaarha hai ngga, wanmanggina Yahudaya tǝ fingya na tǝ tsaurha a Urshalima! A sahad ɗun aten ǝnɗiya wa.
Fingya ahur nun a ndaarha nafiniya tǝrang mbaala kanda teena. Mbǝ ƙǝkafek ni wa! Tsar ni ˈwan ya. Mbǝ mbaala tǝrang fiya teena a tsar kiya wa.
Awo, ˈya nanun a tsar ɗiya ˈwad annabi Djoyel thlǝkƙǝn ƙǝtǝm.”

content.text: “ ‘Ndagha Faara,
a mii ngwala ƙǝshiirha, niya fǝrang Sǝsǝnna fiya heu.
Wangginun nda hǝshya tǝ nishya na nda a thlǝk ˈya ndana Faara,
Wundǝlayi nun na nda a na ǝngya kyaɗang ni kanda,
Tǝ kǝm shinggi nun na nda a sǝsǝniirha.
Ko aten mafayina ni nda nishya tǝ hǝshya heu,
Niya fǝrang sǝsǝnna kanda ahu ɓengginiya,
Tǝ kǝm nanda a pǝr ˈya ndani.
Niya kyad ǝnwulteena hai a frakh amshi,
Tǝ ǝnsakhrha hangga a hweeɗe,
Fara tǝ waarha, tǝ kǝm hashmbe tǝ ine na tikɗik.
Na nda a tsawang yanfaara wula,
Ndǝre kǝm tsauka yiɓa kǝla fara,
Kapa na mamnggit far Chinǝm ɓarha ɓa.
Kala niifa aagha thlǝm Chinǝm,
Nǝn wal hǝrǝkrha.’ ”

content: Nafiya Isǝrela, kaama thlǝmarha hai! Yeeso tǝ Nadzarat niifɗi kyaɗang na Faara kun tǝ ndaarha ka niifani, ǝnaɗǝ ǝnwuteengya mǝmanggǝn tǝ ǝnsakhkya ahur nun kun tǝ altennun sǝnɗunsǝ.
Faara fǝrgha niifɗiya a kun tǝ sǝndǝghǝn, kun kǝm tǝ thlarra fa mbǝlfeeya ɓǝlanggun tǝ taurha ɗǝ aten kaɗiirha.
Amma Faara thleng ɗa sǝ ahu mǝrra tǝ kǝm thliiɗa sǝ tǝ yibrha, ƙǝsǝr mbǝ mǝrra mbang ƙǝsghǝn ha a kwarha wa.
Ndauda kǝm thlǝkɗǝ pathla atenggǝn ndǝghǝn, “Naɗi Chinǝm ƙǝtsar a thlǝmanna. Ƙǝsǝr nǝghǝn a yisǝmanna, mbi tǝrǝm nda wa.”

content.text: “Nanǝn kee, na hurna a lǝghǝtta tǝ wutsefayirha,
Tǝ ƙǝm na miina a falghǝn!
Na fanna a yibrha tǝ mbǝrsaarha.
Ƙǝsǝr mba mal nggi ahu kwad mǝrra wa,
Tǝ kǝmɗa mba nggǝmfa tǝ Peɗǝnduwa mǝlthgha wa.
Kyaɗenna kwaman yibrha,
Na lǝgɗeerha tǝ mbǝnafa a thlǝmad wa.”

content: Kun wanmanggina numama aten ǝnɗiya, mbǝ Ndauda a ndikrha a altenggǝn ahu palthɗi ndani ya wa, ƙǝsǝr mǝrɗǝ pangganda, tǝ ƙǝm ten kwadghǝn ɓalghǝn a thlǝmannǝm.
Amma nanǝn ndǝghǝnggi annabini tǝ kǝm sǝnda sǝ ndangga Faara har tǝ ɗǝf mee, tǝ ndaarha nǝn a tǝrang niifa ahu chichiyighǝn tsawanggǝn ahu tsǝnggam nggǝn.
Nana Ndauda ǝnɗi ɓagha katǝrarha hai a mbee thlǝk pathla nǝn aten thlid Ƙǝrǝsti sǝ ahu mǝrra tǝ ndaarha mal wa ndan hu kwarha wa tǝ ƙǝm mbǝ thlu fadghǝn a mǝthla wa.
Faara thleng ɗǝ Yeeso sǝ ahu mǝrra ƙǝm heu na ɗǝm ndǝn ƙǝkafek ni.

Nanǝnya fǝrang nda mbǝd tsaurha yi tsǝnggam mamnggirha a talara a yisǝmad Faara. Ƙǝla ndana Chinɗi nǝn a fǝrang Sǝsǝna tǝ Peɗǝnda, fǝranggǝnǝn kan ƙǝm ndǝghǝn ɓangga ǝnɗa ɓa nun a naarha tǝ sǝkrha a weeriya.
Ƙǝsǝr Ndauda tafadghǝn ˈwawa tǝra talara ɗe wa, amma ndǝghǝn,

content.text: Chinǝm ndanggǝn China,
“Tsawu a yisǝmanna.
Ƙǝl a tsawang ɗi fa tsanggiwa,
A kamu saryi wa.”

content: “Nanǝn kee, ngwa tsauka tǝ sǝnda ko wunni a Isǝrela tǝ ndaarha Faara ǝnagha Yeeso ɗiya tawang nun ɗǝ a tsauka ndǝghǝnni Chinǝm tǝ ƙǝm Ƙǝrǝsti.”
Sǝkna nafini laɓarɗi ki Mbiturus tsuwar hur ndan nǝn fa, ndangganda Mbiturus tǝ fingya fa thlǝnggini, “Wan manggina ma nan a ǝnaarha?”

Nggǝrangga Mbiturus kanda sǝ, “Kowunni ahur nun tǝtani a malanggǝn ɗimiyidghǝn kyahargha thlǝmad Faara ɓa, ǝnang mbaptisǝma nda ahu thlǝm Yeeso Ƙǝrǝsti yi chakh ɗimiyirha, tǝ nun wal fǝrra Sǝsǝna tǝ Pǝɗǝnda.
Thlǝkna nda pathɗiya ka kun tǝ wangginun tǝ fingya mbuwa wa Yahudaya tǝ nafiya na Faara a aarha ɓa ƙǝm.”
Yiyang thlǝmaarha nǝn kanda teena; tǝ fingya pathya hangga tǝ ƙǝm hwan kanda nǝn, “Hǝrgha man fannun ahu ƙǝshiid weeriya yi mbǝlfeerha.”
Fingya thlǝgha palth Mbiturus kǝm ǝnang mbaptisǝma nda kanda, a farɗiya chik nda tǝ fiya fǝrgha ƙǝkafek takh nda a sǝl haru kumnggitghǝn mahan.
Wum ten fatakkwaya Yeeso
Wum teena nda tǝ fingya fatakkwaya Yeeso, ɗǝf teena nda tǝ tsahad fa thlǝngya Yeeso ha tǝ tsau ɗǝɗemnggirha tǝ ndan hu kyang nda mburodi hai tǝ hwan Faara.
Ko wunni tǝrǝm Faara nǝn, ƙǝsǝr fathlǝnggini a ǝna ǝnwuteengya hangga.
Fa takkwaya Yeeso tsawa nda a mbǝrha tal ndǝghang ngganda ǝnggindan hai na nanda tǝghǝn ha heu.
Heng ngganda ǝnggindan ɗǝ ndǝghang wuɗǝɓǝlghǝnda a fiya na tǝ ɓillarha.

Ka fad ɗathla mbǝrha fa hai na nda ɗǝfang shilee Faara teena ahu Ƙǝn Faara na a Urshalima. Na nda narha wumnda hai ahur wurayindan na nda a kyang mburodi hai hǝb ǝnnarhami nda tǝ wutsǝfayirha tǝ hura tal.

Na nda narha fal Faara nagha shili ndan sǝ a fad fiya heu. Ka parra fara fa na Chinǝm narha chighang fingya kanda walgha hǝrǝkrha. Na nda narha fal Faara nagha shili ndan sǝ a fad fiya heu. Ka parra fara fa na Chinǝm narha chighang fingya kanda walgha hǝrǝkrha.
